en.sayed-ali-raza: It is as though you too have gone where they have gone,
the same sleeping place has caught you and the same place has detained you.
What will then be your position when your affairs reach their end and graves are turned upside down (to throw out the dead)?

“There shall every soul realise what it hath sent before, and they shall be brought back to Allāh, their true Lord, and what they did fabricate (the false deities) will vanish (away) from them.” (Qur’ān, 10:30)
